guidance.statement: We plan to deliver approx. 7.5 to 8 gigawatts in FY27 to deliver an EBITDA about 74% more than what we have delivered in FY26, which therefore works out to a range of 1,500 to 1,600 crores.
9-GW N-type TOPCon solar cell manufacturing facility at Gangaikondan is on schedule to produce its first cells in December 2026, with 9 GW ingot and wafer targeted for FY29

industry: Industrials > Capital Goods > Electrical Equipment > Other Electrical Equipment

operating_notes.text: Approved ₹3,726 crore capex for 6 GW wafer and ingot facility at Gangaikondan by FY29.
FY27 non-DCR volume expected to deliver EBITDA of ₹1.75 to ₹2 per watt peak on average.
Secured a 187 MW order for N-Type TOPCon G12R modules (615–625 Wp, glass-to-glass bifacial) for projects at three locations in Karnataka and Tamil Nadu.
The order is one-time and domestic, with execution to be completed by December 2026; the customer is a leading renewable energy developer already associated with the company.
The filing discloses order size only in MW; no rupee consideration is stated.
9 GW N-type TOPCon cell plant at Gangaikondan, Tamil Nadu is scheduled to produce first cells in December 2026, with planned expansion to 12 GW.
The Gangaikondan campus already houses an operational 6 GW module plant inaugurated in August 2026, and a board-approved 9 GW ingot and wafer facility targeted for FY29.
